_comment: Framework-owned base schedule, always loaded by scheduler.py alongside each chamber's .schedule.json. For cross-cutting jobs that belong to the framework itself, not to any single chamber. Chamber manifests cannot shadow these job ids.

jobs._comment: Pull the feeds each chamber declares in its .news.json. Pure HTTP + parsing, no Claude session; a deployment with no manifest does nothing.
Score what the fetch brought in and fold the user's feedback into the news profile. Gated: spawns a Claude session only when there is unscored news or unconsumed feedback.
Scan every chamber's declared inboxes (.inbox.json) for waiting files. Filesystem gate, no Claude session; dispatches the Archivist only when something is pending, so empty inboxes cost nothing.
